notes.title: Today 18th of April is RELEASE!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

I'm thrilled to announce that after 5 years of development, my game is finally ready for release. These years have been different, but certainly not easy ones. The game underwent many transformations to reach its final shape. I aimed to create a game that was truly worthy and enjoyable, so I poured immense effort and soul into making something special. I handled everything myself - the 3D and 2D art, game logic, game design, and concept.

I'm extremely grateful to my sound designer and composer, SkupDM, also known as Skup Dmytro. He's a courageous individual living in a city that suffers daily from the terrorist attacks of the russian military.

Another interesting twist is that game development is my passion, and to make a living, I work as a seaman. Currently, I'm in the middle of the ocean, and we've recently received Starlink. The future is here; I can now upload all my files without worrying about internet quality. No more waiting 20 minutes to download a mere 5 MB. I can release my game without any technical issues due to internet quality. It's simply amazing!

I hope you enjoy the game!
